resource_type.label: Data repository
resource_type.definition: A service that preserves and provides access to deposited research data.

resource_type.label: Registry or results database
resource_type.definition: A structured registry or results-reporting system rather than a general data-deposition repository.

resource_type.label: Knowledge base
resource_type.definition: A curated information resource that integrates data, evidence, or annotations.

resource_type.label: Data portal
resource_type.definition: A discovery or access interface that may aggregate data held by one or more underlying services.

resource_type.label: Data archive
resource_type.definition: A preservation-oriented service for deposited data and associated records.

resource_type.label: Cloud analysis environment
resource_type.definition: A managed environment for discovering and analyzing data near compute resources.

resource_type.label: Data catalog
resource_type.definition: A service that describes and points to data assets, which may be held elsewhere.

resource_type.label: Biobank or biospecimen resource
resource_type.definition: A resource that manages biospecimens and associated data.

resource_type.label: Model resource
resource_type.definition: A resource focused on organisms, models, software models, or reference constructs.

resource_type.label: Access system
resource_type.definition: A system that manages requests, authorization, or access to controlled data.

resource_type.label: Database
resource_type.definition: A structured information system not otherwise classified.

resource_type.label: Other resource
resource_type.definition: A resource that does not fit another controlled category.

resource_type.label: Not established
resource_type.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to classify the resource.

nih_relationship.label: NIH-maintained
nih_relationship.definition: NIH directly maintains or stewards the resource.

nih_relationship.label: Currently NIH-funded
nih_relationship.definition: Current NIH funding support is documented.

nih_relationship.label: Sustained or historical NIH support
nih_relationship.definition: Sustained or historical NIH support is documented without establishing current operational funding.

nih_relationship.label: NIH ICO-associated
nih_relationship.definition: A documented relationship with one or more NIH Institutes, Centers, or Offices exists.

nih_relationship.label: External resource relevant to NIH-funded research
nih_relationship.definition: The resource is relevant but confirmed NIH support is not established.

nih_relationship.label: NIH relationship not established
nih_relationship.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to classify the NIH relationship.

submission_model.label: Accepts broad investigator deposits
submission_model.definition: The resource accepts deposits from the broader research community.

submission_model.label: Limited or programmatic intake
submission_model.definition: Deposits are limited to specific programs, consortia, cohorts, or approved contributors.

submission_model.label: Not accepting new deposits
submission_model.definition: No current new-deposit pathway is documented or the resource states that intake is closed.

submission_model.label: Deposit intake not applicable
submission_model.definition: The resource is not a data-deposition service.

submission_model.label: Deposit eligibility not established
submission_model.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to determine deposit eligibility.

access_pathway.label: Open access
access_pathway.definition: Data or content can be accessed without registration or authorization.

access_pathway.label: Registered access
access_pathway.definition: Access requires registration or agreement but not case-by-case controlled authorization.

access_pathway.label: Controlled access
access_pathway.definition: Access requires review and authorization through a named access mechanism.

access_pathway.label: Mixed access
access_pathway.definition: The resource contains assets with different access pathways.

access_pathway.label: Restricted access
access_pathway.definition: Access is restricted under terms not otherwise classified.

access_pathway.label: Access requests temporarily paused
access_pathway.definition: The resource exists but is not currently processing new access requests.

access_pathway.label: Access migrated
access_pathway.definition: Access has moved to another resource or platform.

access_pathway.label: Access unavailable
access_pathway.definition: The resource is not currently available for access.

access_pathway.label: Access pathway not established
access_pathway.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to determine the access pathway.

operational_status.label: In transition
operational_status.definition: The resource is migrating or undergoing a material operational transition.

operational_status.label: Temporarily paused
operational_status.definition: Some or all operations are temporarily paused.

operational_status.label: Under review
operational_status.definition: Operations or procedures are under review.

operational_status.label: Sunsetting
operational_status.definition: The resource is winding down or directing users to a successor.

operational_status.label: Archived
operational_status.definition: The resource is retained primarily as an archive.

operational_status.label: Retired
operational_status.definition: The resource is no longer operational as a current service.

operational_status.label: Operational status not established
operational_status.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to determine current status.

evidence_state.label: Verified
evidence_state.definition: Directly checked against authoritative documentation or a bounded live technical test.

evidence_state.label: Officially reported
evidence_state.definition: Reported by NIH, the resource operator, or another authoritative owner but not independently tested.

evidence_state.label: Registry reported
evidence_state.definition: Reported by re3data, FAIRsharing, RRID, or another third-party registry.

evidence_state.label: Not established
evidence_state.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to support the claim.

programmatic_access.label: Public API
programmatic_access.definition: A public programmatic interface is documented.

programmatic_access.label: Authenticated API
programmatic_access.definition: A programmatic interface requiring authentication is documented.

programmatic_access.label: Bulk download
programmatic_access.definition: A documented bulk-download mechanism is available.

programmatic_access.label: Cloud workspace
programmatic_access.definition: Data can be analyzed through a managed cloud workspace.

programmatic_access.label: No public API reported
programmatic_access.definition: Evidence indicates that no public API is offered.

programmatic_access.label: Programmatic access not established
programmatic_access.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to characterize programmatic access.

pid_level.label: Dataset-level persistent identifier
pid_level.definition: Persistent identifiers are assigned at the dataset or equivalent asset level.

pid_level.label: Collection-level persistent identifier
pid_level.definition: Persistent identifiers are assigned to collections or releases.

pid_level.label: Repository-level identifier only
pid_level.definition: A persistent identifier identifies the resource but not necessarily its individual assets.

pid_level.label: No persistent identifier documented
pid_level.definition: No relevant persistent identifier practice is documented.

pid_level.label: Persistent identifier practice not established
pid_level.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to characterize PID practice.

fit_class.label: Meets selected criteria
fit_class.definition: Every selected criterion is supported by current evidence.

fit_class.label: Meets with caveats
fit_class.definition: Core criteria match, but one or more caveats require attention.

fit_class.label: Near match
fit_class.definition: The resource matches some but not all selected criteria.

fit_class.label: Insufficient evidence
fit_class.definition: The tracker lacks enough evidence to determine fit.

fit_class.label: Excluded by selected criteria
fit_class.definition: Current evidence conflicts with one or more required criteria.

data_modality.label: Behavioral, social, and population health data
Physiologic signals, wearables, and mobile health
Models, software, workflows, notebooks, and containers
Ontologies, vocabularies, common data elements, and terminology artifacts
Synthetic data, benchmark datasets, and challenge data

organism_scope.label: Human data or participants
organism_scope.definition: The resource documents human participants, patients, cohorts, or human-derived data.

organism_scope.label: Non-human organisms or data
organism_scope.definition: The resource documents non-human organisms, pathogens, or non-human biological systems.

organism_scope.label: Human and non-human or multi-species
organism_scope.definition: The resource documents both human and non-human data or explicitly supports multiple species.

organism_scope.label: Model systems or preclinical resources
organism_scope.definition: The resource documents experimental models, cell lines, organoids, animal models, or other preclinical systems.

organism_scope.label: Organism or model-system scope not established
organism_scope.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to characterize organism or model-system scope.

human_data_sensitivity.label: Controlled or potentially sensitive human data
human_data_sensitivity.definition: Human-related data are documented with controlled or restricted access. This does not independently classify consent, legal, or privacy status.

human_data_sensitivity.label: Open or registered human-data access
human_data_sensitivity.definition: Human-related data are documented with open or registered access. This does not by itself establish de-identification.

human_data_sensitivity.label: Mixed human-data access
human_data_sensitivity.definition: The resource documents human-related assets with more than one access pathway.

human_data_sensitivity.label: No human-data context established
human_data_sensitivity.definition: Available organism evidence is explicitly non-human or model-system focused.

human_data_sensitivity.label: Human-data sensitivity not established
human_data_sensitivity.definition: Available evidence is insufficient to characterize human-data sensitivity or access context.
